demo.title: endpoint-record.sh
demo.code:
# Decide before buying a fresh Base token ($0.02)
bankr prompt "Use endpoint-record to check 0x<token> on Base. Buy only if action is ALLOW, and tell me the reasons."

# Was the liquidity already pulled?
bankr prompt "Run endpoint-record on 0x<token> and show contract.liquidityHistory and the sell simulation result"

setup: No install required: one POST endpoint behind x402
Fund a Base wallet with USDC (0.02 per call)
Act on `action` (ALLOW / RECHECK / BLOCK), not on the verdict label
Check `dataAgeSeconds` before acting; ask again on RECHECK
